Voter list issues reported in Telangana ahead of elections

Ahead of elections in Telangana, reports highlight issues with voter lists. A trade unionist's name was reportedly missing, while elderly and uneducated voters in agency areas faced difficulties with enumeration forms. These incidents raise concerns about the accuracy and accessibility of the electoral roll.
